Quick start

1. Update Employee Master first. 2. Choose an allowance section. 3. Enter Employee Number and select the dates worked. 4. Save the entry.

Sunday allowance follows the current Excel calculation. Overtime allowance uses ₹40 per selected date, matching the uploaded template.

Important

Data is saved in this browser on this computer. Export a backup regularly. Employee numbers remain reserved even after an employee is marked inactive. Saved allowance entries keep a snapshot of employee details at entry time.

Employee list

Search — Employee Allowance History

Historical data from the uploaded COMPOFF and REFRESHMENT ZIP files is included in this app. Enter an Employee Number or name to see Sunday Working and Overtime Duty history. If an old row has no dates, it will say so rather than guess.

Historical rows loaded: 11,485 total — 9,656 Sunday Working and 1,829 Overtime Duty. 6,648 rows are linked to an Employee Number; 4,837 name-only/ambiguous rows need manual linking for Employee Number search. 176 source rows do not contain dates. Where an old Excel has a total for multiple dates, the app allocates it across listed dates for a per-date view; the original row total is preserved.

Date-wise COMPOFF List

Find all employees who worked on a particular date, or view one month's date-wise list. This list is for Sunday Working / COMPOFF records and includes employee number, name, amount and daily totals.

Choose a specific date or a month, then Search. If neither is chosen, Search shows the selected year date-wise records.

Old Excel rows needing Employee Number

Some older Excel sheets have names but no Employee Number. Search for a name, choose the correct Employee Number, then link all rows with that exact name. Please verify carefully before linking.

Allowance Reports

Print Allowance Lists

A4 print format. Both OT and COMPOFF/Sunday pages are limited to ₹9,999 total. Entries for the same work date appear together where possible, including multiple entries for one employee.

Print is filtered by Entry Date. Sunday / COMPOFF: latest Sunday-only workers appear on Page A; anyone with earlier Sunday work appears together on Page B with all dates and total amount in one row. OT keeps all dates together. Each page is limited to ₹9,999.
